issue_request: FHIR-41633 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked FHIR-I to clarify that context.type=element can match an element's assigned datatype, not only ElementDefinition.id, with the Jira example of expression string applying to elements such as Device.lotNumber.

That left the terminology definition correct, but the build-scoped Defining Extensions narrative still lacked the approved datatype example.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms the intended interpretation: Grahame Grieve explained that a typed element has both its element id and the id of the root type. Confluence WGM minutes record the FHIR-41633 Persuasive with Modification motion at 24-0-0. Later related FHIR-43364 and FHIR-46620 context clarifications touched the same guidance family without reversing the assigned-type rule and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Edited source/defining-extensions.html#context to say that an assigned type is also treated as an element id for context matching and to give the requested string/Device.lotNumber example.
